rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans font-normal leading-relaxed text-slate-200

entry_surfaces./: mobile-first sports command center — hero story & live tournaments header, sport pill selectors, community pickup rosters & tournament brackets grid, bottom navigation bar
entry_surfaces./login: tactical athletic split-view modal/screen — dual tab Google OAuth & WhatsApp OTP auth with live verification feedback, community perks teaser

layouts.viewport_model: mobile-first responsive (max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative shadow-2xl bg-[#0B0F17] pb-24 border-x border-[#1E293B]/40)
layouts.bottom_navigation: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto z-50 h-16 bg-[#0B0F17]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#223147] flex items-center justify-around px-2
layouts.desktop_presentation: On larger screens (lg/xl), center the device frame with an immersive tactical athletic backdrop pattern, showing mobile viewport in high fidelity while responsive for desktop interaction

component_hierarchy.name: NavigationHeader
component_hierarchy.description: Sticky app header with location/city picker, notification bell, sport category switcher (All, Football, Padel/Tennis, Basketball, Cricket, Volleyball), and quick search

component_hierarchy.name: LiveTournamentCard
component_hierarchy.description: High-impact tournament card with prize pool badge, live stage indicator, organizer profile, registered teams counter, entry fee (with OMR / USD support), and bracket preview CTA

component_hierarchy.name: CommunityPickupSession
component_hierarchy.description: Recurring match card (e.g. 'Sunday Champions 7v7', 'Tuesday Padel Night') with real-time RSVP roster, spot counter ('11/14 Joined'), team formation (Team Red vs Team White), and 1-tap join button

component_hierarchy.name: InteractiveTournamentBracket
component_hierarchy.description: Horizontal swipeable knockout bracket (Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Grand Final) with live score updates, winner highlight, and match stats popup

component_hierarchy.name: HostMonetizationPaywall
component_hierarchy.description: Organiser Pro monetization dashboard & Stripe checkout paywall. Shows revenue projector ($450/month potential hosting 2 weekly matches), ticket management, automatic fee collection, payout stats, and subscription tier selection

component_hierarchy.name: AuthWhatsAppGoogleModal
component_hierarchy.description: Dual auth modal supporting 1-tap Google login and fast WhatsApp OTP (+968 Oman and international country codes) with numeric code entry and immediate session launch

component_hierarchy.name: CreateCommunityModal
component_hierarchy.description: Form to start a recurring sports group (select days like Sun/Tue, sport, max players, venue, entry fee, public/private)

component_hierarchy.name: CreateTournamentModal
component_hierarchy.description: Tournament creator wizard (single elimination/group stage, team size, prize money, registration deadline, rulebook)

image_urls.description: High intensity basketball tournament game action
Community soccer/football friendly match on grass

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with 8px Y slide up (0.22s ease-out)

accessibility.color_contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA compliant: on_bg #F8FAFC and #FFFFFF against #0B0F17 (#131B2A) exceeds 14:1 contrast ratio. Primary CTA accent #FF5722 text is pure white with 4.7:1 ratio.
accessibility.aria_roles: All dialogs, tabs, and interactive bracket items have role and aria-selected / aria-expanded states
accessibility.test_attributes: All buttons, tabs, inputs, filters, and cards MUST include explicit data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENT MOBILE-FIRST CONTAINER: Render the entire application centered in a mobile viewport frame (w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#0B0F17] text-white shadow-2xl relative).

2. BOTTOM NAVIGATION BAR: Keep the fixed bottom navigation with 5 distinct operational modes: Explore/Feed, Communities (Recurring groups), Tournaments (Brackets & Official events), Host & Earn (Stripe Monetization), and My Games (Profile & RSVP history).

3. SEED RICH TEST DATA: Provide 6+ sports (Football, Basketball, Padel, Tennis, Cricket, Volleyball) with real scheduled matches (Sunday 8 PM, Tuesday 7 PM), populated rosters with avatars, active tournaments with 8-team brackets, and community earnings data.
4. DUAL AUTHENTICATION: Support 1-click Google sign in and WhatsApp OTP phone login (with Oman +968 and global country codes) with test instant verification.

5. RECURRING COMMUNITY GAMES: Enable users to join recurring sessions, toggle their RSVP ('Add my name to team roster'), pick Team A / Team B, view match fee split, and create new weekly community groups.
6. TOURNAMENT MANAGEMENT: Include interactive knockout brackets, live score updates, match reporting, and prize pool breakdowns.
7. ORGANISER PRO MONETIZATION: Dedicated 'Host & Earn' tab featuring a dynamic revenue calculator, Stripe Checkout subscription modal, instant match ticket fee collection, and organizer analytics.

8. SHADCN UI COMPATIBILITY: Use Base-UI compliant Shadcn components from @/components/ui/ (Dialog, Tabs, Badge, Button, Input, Select, Sonner toasts). Always use sonner for all booking and creation alerts.
9. TEST IDS: Include rigorous data-testid attributes on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid="rsvp-join-btn", data-testid="sport-filter-football", data-testid="subscribe-pro-plan").
